chart.name: # Requests/sec

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('apache.requests', rollup='delta').sum(by=['sf_metric']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10, over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50, over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90, over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='F')
